per_book_rate_verdict: flat (~0.26/book) across 270 years; per-year 'acceleration' is a corpus-density artifact
robust_finding: unsupervised genre recovery from prose, validated by held-out labels; genre-rate-over-time NOT supported

controls.verdict: No global mutation rate. After controlling density, style drift, and author voice, detective fiction is the one robust, label-validated temporal emergence; the rest are perennial modes.

term_split.question: is 'mystery story' a new genre or a renaming of detective fiction?
term_split.settled: It is NOT a renaming. Detective fiction grows rather than ceding ground across the same decades.
